What we do

Full-service landscaping, start to finish

From a weekly mow to a complete backyard transformation, one trusted crew handles it all.

Lawn Care & Mowing

Reliable mowing, edging, trimming and cleanup on a schedule that keeps your yard sharp all season.

Landscape Design & Build

Custom planting plans, hardscape and full yard makeovers tailored to your space and how you use it.

Patios & Stone Work

Flagstone patios, paver walkways, retaining walls and steps built to last in Colorado weather.

Sod, Seeding & Mulch

A thick, green lawn from the ground up, fresh mulch and tidy, healthy planting beds.

Trimming & Pruning

Shrubs, hedges and small trees shaped, thinned and kept healthy for a clean, cared-for look.

Seasonal Cleanups

Spring and fall cleanups, leaf removal and bed refreshes that reset your yard for what's next.

Outdoor living spaces that fit your home

Water features & design

Backyards with a little more character

Frequently asked questions

Do you offer free estimates?

Yes. Tell us about your project and we'll give you a clear, no-obligation quote — usually within a business day.

What areas do you serve?

We're based in Lakewood and serve the greater Denver metro and surrounding Colorado communities.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, we're fully insured so your property is covered and you can hire us worry-free.

What kinds of projects do you take on?

Everything from regular lawn care and cleanups to patios, retaining walls, water features and full landscape design and build.

How soon can you come out?

Often within a few days. Send us a message or give us a call and we'll find the soonest slot that works for you.
